description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST in REBINDING does NOT carry Option 54 (server identifier) (RFC 2131 §4.3.6 table 5)
approach:
[Objective]
The REBINDING REQUEST is broadcast precisely because the original server might be down — pinning to it via Option 54 would defeat the fallback. Table 5 in RFC 2131 §4.3.6 marks Option 54 as MUST NOT in rebinding.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING REQUEST.
3. T2 → REBINDING → rebind DHCPREQUEST
   • options blob does NOT contain Option 54   ← key check

[Pass condition]
No Option 54 inside the REBINDING REQUEST options blob.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_rebinding_request_carries_server_id — REQUEST illegally carries Option 54.

verdicts.Pass: REBINDING REQUEST has no Option 54 — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST after ACK
verdicts.Fail_no_rebinding_request: No DUT rebinding DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_rebinding_request_carries_server_id: DUT rebinding REQUEST illegally carries server-id
